brief: Read or probe console events with original locking, pending-byte, mode restoration and overlapping scan decoding.

bookkeeping.scope: Complete lock wrappers, inner read/probe, decoder and open helper; explicit console API and lock bridges.
bookkeeping.supported_domain: Mapped console window and records; normal scans 0..255, any enhanced scan; finite event streams and successful bounded dynamic allocations; APIs populate fields subsequently read, including saved mode. Invalid original accesses and uninitialized out-parameters unmodeled.
bookkeeping.acceptance: 1932 original cases across six complete routines and four persistent console/fallback ten-call traces match MSVC and Zig exactly; independent buffer, mode, filter, alias, error and forwarding tests pass.
unresolved: Actual console API and lock adapters, uninitialized API out-parameters and allocation-fault behavior, live input and process cleanup.
